name: Clean Waterskin (Mold)
description: Scour a musty skin with ash and boiled water.

crit_success.message: Sweet as new leather. (Clean state belongs to the task-703 executor; the skin is kept.)

success.message: Must gone — the skin is clean and kept.

fail.message: Still musty, but usable. Ash and water spent.
